versions.subject: Create web_cve_2022_27925_exploit.yml
versions.detection:
selection_servlet:
    cs-method: 'POST'
    c-uri|contains: '/service/extension/backup/mboximport?'
selection_uri:
    c-uri|contains|all:
        - 'account-name'
        - 'ow'
        - 'no-switch'
        - 'append'
selection_status:
    sc-status:
        - '401'
        - '200'
selection_noauth:
    - cs-cookie: 'ZM_AUTH_TOKEN'
condition: all of selection*
